Northbank Community Garden

The north gate will be closed on Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm to repair a leaking water pipe. Use the east entrance during the closure.

The seed swap moves to Sunday at 11 am.

Volunteers are needed for the repair. Bring gloves; tools are supplied. Mina coordinates volunteers, so check in with her when you arrive.
